gripOrHq.title: Rush Hour
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If run is successful, access three additional cards from R&D. You cannot use noisy icebreakers during the run.

gripOrHq.title: Karl de Veres, Corporate Stooge
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [1] after each successful run. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

gripOrHq.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
gripOrHq.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

gripOrHq.title: Inside Job
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

gripOrHq.title: Vewy Vewy Quiet
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Vewy Vewy Quiet when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: HQ Interface

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

ice.title: Hunter
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

ice.title: Ball and Chain
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.

ice.title: Rex
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 3 - If trace is successful, end the run, and Runner cannot run again until Runner takes an action to pay [2].

root.title: Vapor Ops
root.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.
